title: CI time caps start generous and warn before they fire
why: Your gripe, Oct 23: CI that is new, or that just gained tests, keeps timing out and failing.
note: Checked at 1842e56: skill ci-hygiene step 5 sets each job's cap at about 2x its slowest green run. A new job has no green run to measure, and a growing suite outgrows its cap silently; the only signal is a timeout that reads like a test failure. Seen here: Oct 17, two gates runs cancelled at 18 min with every step green (debt gates-job-near-timeout); Oct 22, the macOS cap raised from 25 to 50 min; #562's merge wait ran out while CI was green (c34). Which other repos hit it: unknown, you named it as a pattern. Fix: a provisional 60-minute cap until 5 green runs; the merge tool warns when a job used over 70% of its cap; a timeout with all steps green gets its own verdict ('re-cap or split'), not a drop; the merge wait follows the caps. Change in this chat: no hard-coded CI caps in my briefs; caps come from measured runs. Lane ci-time-caps in batch 3 of goal 2 (full text on c37), together with c34.
